crops.name: Rice
crops.intended_role: Kharif baseline for comparing documented diversification sequences; not a default recommendation.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature above 35 degC during anthesis/flowering increases spikelet sterility (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Optimal growing season mean temperature 20-30 degC. Growth ceases below 10 degC or above 36 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: puddled rice, surface irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: PAU cautions that direct-seeded rice can fail in light-textured soils because of severe iron deficiency; this does not generalize to every method.

nutrient_characteristics.notes: No nutrient-balance or soil-improvement value is assigned.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: PAU includes rice dwarfing-disease management; no farm risk rule is defined.

indicative_economics.notes: Government of India MSP 2024-25 (Rs 2300/q for Common paddy). High assured public procurement in Punjab.

crops.name: Maize
crops.intended_role: Kharif cereal alternative represented in PAU multi-cropping systems.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature above 38 degC during pollination and silking impairs grain set (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Optimal growing season mean temperature 18-33 degC. Growth stalls below 10 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: kharif maize, surface irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Kharif 2024-25 MSP. Core diversification alternative to paddy in Punjab crop zoning.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.intended_role: Kharif commercial-crop option with a documented Cotton-Wheat sequence.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 42 degC induces severe square and boll shedding (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Warm-season C3 fiber crop. Optimal mean temperature 22-36 degC. Fails below 15 degC or above 42 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: American/Bt cotton, surface furrow/basin irrigation; total water requirement from GoI Annexure AS110 & PAU Kharif.

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: PAU records thrips-management guidance; this catalogue does not derive a pest-risk score.

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Kharif 2024-25 MSP for medium staple cotton. High gross revenue potential in south-western Punjab.

crops.name: Moong (mungbean)
crops.intended_role: Short summer legume in multiple documented Punjab sequences.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 40 degC accelerates flower drop and reduces pod setting (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Short-duration pulse. Optimal mean temperature 21-36 degC. Fails below 8 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: summer moongbean, drip irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

nutrient_characteristics.notes: Legume status is recorded; no nitrogen contribution or fertilizer credit is assumed.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

crop_coefficient.source: FAO-56 Table 12 (beans, green/dry — proxy for mung bean)

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Kharif/Summer 2024-25 MSP. Short 60-day duration, low operational cost, and biological nitrogen fixation.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.intended_role: Kharif legume alternative appearing in PAU conservation-agriculture sequences.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature above 38 degC during reproductive stages impairs pod fill and nodulation (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Optimal growing season mean temperature 20-33 degC. Growth inhibited below 10 degC or above 38 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: Soybean, surface irrigation; total water requirement from GoI Annexure AS110 & PAU Kharif.

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

nutrient_characteristics.notes: Legume status is recorded; no nitrogen contribution or fertilizer credit is assumed.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

crops.evidence_quality: high_regional_for_inclusion and documented sequence; constraints unverified

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Kharif 2024-25 MSP. Nitrogen-fixing legume cash crop with modest irrigation requirements.

crops.name: Bajra (pearl millet)
crops.intended_role: Kharif cereal/fodder candidate included to preserve a documented non-rice option.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Highly heat tolerant C4 cereal; extreme heat above 42 degC causes leaf scorch and floret sterility (PAU Kharif 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Drought- and heat-resilient C4 cereal. Optimal mean temperature 25-35 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: pearl millet (bajra), surface irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: PAU states bajra (pearl millet) is sensitive to waterlogging and performs best on well-drained light-to-medium textured soils.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

crops.evidence_quality: moderate_regional_for_inclusion; crop purpose and constraints need reviewer confirmation

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Kharif 2024-25 MSP. Extremely drought-hardy C4 millet with minimal input requirements.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.intended_role: Rabi baseline and successor in many PAU-documented rotations.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 32 degC during March grain filling causes terminal heat stress and forced maturity (PAU Rabi 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Cool-season C3 cereal. Optimal mean temperature 15-23 degC. Highly vulnerable to terminal heat stress above 32 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: wheat, surface irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: PAU states wheat can grow on all soils except highly deteriorated alkaline and water-logged soils; durum wheat prefers medium to fine textures.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Rabi 2024-25 MSP (raised to Rs 2425 for 2025-26 marketing). Assured public procurement staple in Punjab.

crops.name: Chickpea (gram)
crops.intended_role: Rabi pulse alternative in a documented Rice-Gram-Summer Moong sequence.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 32 degC during flowering causes flower and pod abortion (PAU Rabi 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Cool-season legume. Optimal mean temperature 15-29 degC. Vulnerable to late-season heat stress above 32 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: Desi/Kabuli gram, surface irrigation; total water requirement from GoI Annexure AS110 & PAU Rabi.

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

nutrient_characteristics.notes: Legume status is recorded; no nitrogen contribution or fertilizer credit is assumed.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: PAU has a bio-intensive IPM module for gram caterpillar; this is not a field risk score.

crops.evidence_quality: high_regional_for_inclusion and one documented sequence; constraints unverified

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Rabi 2024-25 MSP. Deep-rooted cool-season pulse saving significant irrigation water relative to wheat.

crops.name: Rapeseed and mustard crop group
crops.intended_role: Rabi oilseed group with PAU planting windows and soil context; type selection remains separate.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 30 degC during siliqua/pod development causes premature drying and shriveled seeds (PAU Rabi 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Rabi oilseed. Optimal mean temperature 15-28 degC. High sensitivity to early frost and late heat above 30 degC.

water_requirement.method_context: mustard, surface irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: PAU states rapeseed and mustard grow best on well-drained light-to-medium textured soils; types differ.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific crop type.

indicative_economics.notes: GoI Rabi 2024-25 MSP. High-value oilseed with very low seasonal irrigation requirement (175-225 mm).

crops.name: Potato
crops.intended_role: Short Rabi commercial-crop option in PAU multi-crop sequences.

temperature_suitability.extreme_heat_threshold_context: Daily maximum temperature exceeding 30 degC halts tuber initiation and bulking (PAU Rabi 2026 / EcoCrop).
temperature_suitability.notes: Cool-season tuber. Optimal mean temperature 15-25 degC. Tuberization fails above 30 degC day temperature.

water_requirement.method_context: potato, drip irrigation; total crop water requirement (irrigation plus effective rainfall)

soil_constraints.notes: No field soil threshold is entered.

pest_disease_restrictions.notes: No risk forecast or rotation restriction has been validated.
pest_disease_restrictions.evidence_needed: Current Punjab crop-protection guidance tied to a specific risk.

crops.evidence_quality: high_regional_for_inclusion and sequence examples; soil and pest constraints unverified

indicative_economics.notes: Commercial horticultural crop not covered under central MSP. High capital/seed cost and volatile farmgate prices.
